'''Eradication Day''' was the name used by the [[Eagle's network]] members during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] for the final step of their plan that consisted in activating the [[Eradicator (weapon)|Eradicator weapons]] to destroy the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. However, they were unaware that this plan was masterminded by [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Jadus]] in order to eliminate his rivals and take control of the Empire. The plot was eventually foiled by [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Eradication Day only occurs if the player picks one of the two Dark Side options at the end of Chapter 1 of the Imperial Agent story. In the Light Side options the Eradicators are never fired.
